<thought>The mass spectrum shows a base peak at m/z 199.0, which corresponds to [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈197.992 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈9 % M+1 and ≈9 % M+2) is consistent with a molecule containing about 8 carbons (≈8 % M+1 from ¹³C) and two sulfurs (≈8 % M+2 from ³⁴S). A formula that matches the exact mass and isotopic pattern is C₈H₆O₂S₂ (monoisotopic mass 197.981 Da, within experimental error). 

Thus the molecular formula is:

C8H6O2S2</thought>
<final_answer>C8H6O2S2</final_answer>
